readmeExcerpt:
# TypeScript







[TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) is a language for application-scale JavaScript. TypeScript adds optional types to JavaScript that support tools for large-scale JavaScript applications for any browser, for any host, on any OS. TypeScript compiles to readable, standards-based JavaScript. Try it out at the [playground](https://www.typescriptlang.org/play/), and stay up to date via [our blog](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/) and [Twitter account](https://twitter.com/typescript).

Find others who are using TypeScript at [our community page](https://www.typescriptlang.org/community/).

## Installing

For the latest stable version:

```bash
npm install -D typescript
```

For our nightly builds:

```bash
npm install -D typescript@next
```

## Contribute

There are many ways to [contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md) to TypeScript.
* [Submit bugs](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues) and help us verify fixes as they are checked in.
* Review the [source code changes](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/pulls).
* Engage with other TypeScript users and developers on [StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/typescript).
* Help each other in the [TypeScript Community Discord](https://discord.gg/typescript).
* Join the [#typescript](https://twitter.com/search?q=%23TypeScript) discussion on Twitter.
* [Contribute bug fixes](CONTRIBUTING.md).

This project has adopted the [Microsoft Open Source Code of Conduct](https://opensource.microsoft.com/codeofconduct/). For more information see
the [Code of Conduct FAQ](https://opensource.microsoft.com/codeofconduct/faq/) or contact [opencode@microsoft.com](mailto:opencode@microsoft.com)
with any additional questions or comments.

## Documentation

*  [TypeScript in 5 minutes](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/typescript-in-5-minutes.html)
*  [Programming handbook](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/intro.html)
*  [Homepage](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)

## Roadmap

For details on our planned features and future direction, please refer to our [roadmap](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/wiki/Roadmap).

aiSummary.oneLiner: A strongly typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean, standard JavaScript for large-scale application development.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: TypeScript adds optional static typing to JavaScript to enable better tooling, early error detection, and safer refactoring for large-scale codebases. It is designed to run in any browser, on any host, and within any operating system by compiling down to standard, readable JavaScript. By providing powerful features like interfaces, enums, and advanced type inference, it acts as a robust development layer that prevents common runtime errors. The compiler actively checks types during development, ensuring that complex applications remain maintainable and scalable. It allows developers to incremently adopt strict typing without sacrificing the inherent flexibility of the JavaScript ecosystem.
keyFeatures: Static Type Checking: Catch potential runtime errors at compile time by adding optional type annotations to variables and functions.
Advanced Editor Support: Enable rich autocompletion, safe refactoring, and inline documentation in IDEs like Visual Studio Code.
JavaScript Compatibility: Compile directly to clean, standards-based JavaScript that runs reliably on any modern browser or Node.js environment.
Gradual Adoption: Allow developers to incrementally add strict type checking to existing JavaScript codebases without requiring a complete rewrite.
Object-Oriented Constructs: Utilize interfaces, classes, and generic types to enforce strict architectural contracts across large engineering teams.

useCases.title: Large-Scale Web Applications
useCases.description: Building complex frontend codebases where strict typing prevents regressions and facilitates collaboration among dozens of developers.

useCases.title: Robust Backend Development
useCases.description: Creating resilient Node.js servers with predictable API contracts and strongly typed data models.

useCases.title: Library Authorship
useCases.description: Publishing npm packages with integrated type definitions to provide immediate IntelliSense to consumers.

useCases.title: Safe Refactoring
useCases.description: Renaming variables and modifying function signatures across hundreds of files with confidence that the compiler will catch all misalignments.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: JavaScript developers, frontend and backend engineering teams, and framework authors seeking better tooling, type safety, and maintainability for complex applications.
